import numpy as np
# Build transform based on separators color5: each rectangular region between full separator rows/cols; output 1 if >1 cells differ from background.
def transform(grid):
    g=[list(r) for r in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    sep_rows=[r for r in range(h) if all(x==g[r][0] for x in g[r])]
    sep_cols=[c for c in range(w) if all(g[r][c]==g[0][c] for r in range(h))]
    # For these puzzles separators are uniform-color lines; identify most frequent line value
    # boundaries via full-color row/col separators
    rowcuts=[-1]+sep_rows+[h]
    colcuts=[-1]+sep_cols+[w]
    out=[]
    for ri in range(len(rowcuts)-1):
        row=[]
        for ci in range(len(colcuts)-1):
            cells=[g[r][c] for r in range(rowcuts[ri]+1,rowcuts[ri+1]) for c in range(colcuts[ci]+1,colcuts[ci+1])]
            # background is modal color; marker cells are non-background; report panels with >1 marker
            from collections import Counter
            counts=Counter(cells)
            bg=counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
            row.append(1 if sum(v for k,v in counts.items() if k!=bg)>1 else 2)
        out.append(row)
    return out
